description:
Server and Client Connectivity/ ETL Ab Initio tool knowledge - GDE, OC/ Establishing connectivity between EME and GDE 
 EME administration/ Creating projects/ Migrating artifacts/ EME migrations/ Managing users/ Key procurement Users Co-Op 
 Understanding of Unix/Linux system, file systems, shell scripting 
 Extensive experience in architecting ETL solutions 
 Strong knowledge of Performance tuning on any RDBMS (SQL Server, Oracle, DB2 etc.) 
 Good awareness of Enterprise Data Warehousing (EDW), Analytics, Enterprise Dashboard, Key performance Indicators (KPIs), Data Quality, Master Data Management, Data governance and DB appliances is desired 
 Willingness to work with multiple project teams in tandem in a technical consultation role. 
 Excellent analytical and problem solving skills. 
 Should have excellent communication and customer presentation skills. 
 Experience and desire to work in a Global delivery environment, engaging with teams in an onsite/offshore model. 
 Experience and understanding of in Production support and performance engineering. 

 Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education. 
 At least 2 years of experience in Ab Initio Development 
 At least 2 years of experience in Platform Support 
 At least 2 years of experience in Project life cycle activities on DW/BI development and maintenance projects 
 At least 2 years of experience in Environment Support. 

 Job Status: Full Time 
 
 Eligibility: EAD GC or GC or US Citizens 
 
 
 Share the Profiles to mkonni(at)1stitsolutions.com 
 Contact: 703-349-1214 
 Keep the subject line with Job Title and Location
